metadata.title: Ticketed Learning--Unlearning Schemes
metadata.venue: Proceedings of Thirty Sixth Conference on Learning Theory

locators: Appendix B.1 immediately following proof of Theorem 22, PDF p.21
entries.finding: Their main definition is explicitly one-shot and charges central bits and each ticket separately. The current comparison is accurate. However, Appendix B.1 explicitly notes that its threshold scheme supports multi-shot unlearning; adding this caveat would prevent a reader from interpreting the current contrast as claiming that the entire paper cannot handle sequential requests.
entries.recommended_insertion: Their threshold construction also supports multiple requests (Appendix B.1); our distinction is the stated canonical remaining-horizon state contract.
